title: Photorealistic cinematic vertical smartp
prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic vertical smartphone selfie of a clearly adult young woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, seated at a casual contemporary hot-pot restaurant table. Her ethnicity or race should remain unspecified because it cannot be reliably determined from appearance alone. She has smooth fair-to-light skin with warm neutral undertones and realistic natural texture, a softly tapered oval face, delicate jawline, small refined nose, neatly shaped dark brows, and large dark-brown almond-shaped eyes opened brightly toward the camera. Her lips are painted vivid glossy red, and she gives a broad cheerful smile showing her teeth, creating an energetic, friendly, playful expression. Makeup is polished but natural aside from the strong red lip, with subtle eyeliner, defined lashes, softly luminous cheeks, and clean even complexion.

Her hair is a straight chin-to-shoulder-length bob in dark reddish brown, slightly tousled around the sides of her face. She wears a distressed dark gray baseball cap with a curved brim, frayed edges, and large embroidered lettering across the front. A delicate gold chain necklace with a small pendant rests against her upper chest.

She is seated close to the camera in a relaxed, slightly reclined posture, torso angled diagonally across the frame. One arm extends outward toward the camera to take the selfie, creating mild wide-angle perspective distortion, while the other hand rests naturally on her upper thigh. She wears exactly a fitted heather-gray short-sleeve cropped T-shirt with a low rounded neckline and a visible white elastic logo band around the lower hem, exposing a narrow section of midriff. She pairs it with high-waisted medium-blue denim jeans and a black belt with a large oval metallic buckle.

In front of her is a light wood restaurant table holding a small stainless-steel hot-pot filled with broth and vegetables, white bowls, a cup of light-colored tea, a black dish of chopped red chilies, plates, a spoon, and additional food dishes. Behind the table is an open restaurant counter with stacked bowls, cookware, storage bins, utensils, and warm wood cabinetry. A second patron appears softly in the far background near a bright doorway. Use bright mixed indoor restaurant lighting, soft warm highlights, slightly cool daylight spill from the background, realistic reflections on metal cookware, lively natural color, mild smartphone HDR, subtle cinematic contrast, crisp facial detail, 24mm-equivalent wide-angle phone lens, close selfie perspective, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, candid social-media photography aesthetic, 9:16.
